original_fluxes_fragment.source:
! ----------------------------------------------------------------------

! --- determine qbot if not specified
!      if (swbotb == 5 .OR. swbotb == 7 .OR. swbotb == 8 .OR. swbotb == -2 .OR. (swbotb == 1 .AND. fllowgwl) .OR. swbotb == 9) then
      if (swbotb == 5 .OR. swbotb == 7 .OR. swbotb == 8 .OR. swbotb == -2 .OR. (swbotb == 1 .AND. fllowgwl)) then
         qbot = qtop + qrosum + qdrtot  + (volact-volm1)/dt - qssdisum
         if (swmacro == 1) qbot = qbot - QMaPo
      end if

! --- calculate fluxes (cm/d) from changes in volume per compartment
      i      = numnod+1
      q(i)   = qbot
      inq(i) = inq(i) + q(i)*dt
      do i = numnod, 1, -1
         if (swmacro == 0) then
            q(i) = - (theta(i)-thetm1(i)+qimmob(i))*dz(i)/dt + q(i+1)-qrot(i)+qssdi(i)
         else
            q(i) = - (theta(i)-thetm1(i)+qimmob(i))*FrArMtrx(i)*dz(i)/dt + q(i+1)-qrot(i)+QExcMpMtx(i)+qssdi(i)
         end if
         q(i)   = q(i) - sum(qdra(1:nrlevs,i))
         inq(i) = inq(i) + q(i)*dt
      end do
